ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white geometric zones occupying the lateral lobes, bordered by a continuous low-intensity black perimeter. Heavy low-intensity mottling and stippling originate from the central peduncle region, extending outward along the inferior margin of the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile characterized by multiple sharp peaks and valleys (3-15 pixel amplitude variations) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the superior trailing edges, transitioning to a sharp angular taper at the distal terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-contrast, textured circular pixel nodes located on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible across the medial and lateral white fields of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch/indentation on the upper-left trailing edge that deviates from the standard serration frequency.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical dark pigmentation 'feathering' where the central black region meets the white lobe surfaces, particularly prominent on the lower interior edge of the left lobe.
